title: Tweedieverse
text: row describes one feature–covariate coefficient. Factor variables can produce several rows per feature, one per non-reference level. examples use median_comparison = FALSE default log link. feature , metadata , value : Feature identifier, tested covariate, factor level continuous predictor name. Factor effects relative reference level. coef , stderr : Estimated coefficient standard error link scale. log link, exp(coef) fitted mean ratio equal offsets. Continuous covariates standardized default, coefficients describe one-standard-deviation increase unless standardize = FALSE . pval , qval : Unadjusted test p-value multiple-testing adjusted p-value (Benjamini–Hochberg default across reported coefficient tests within assay). base.model , tweedie.index : Model engine/family label estimated fixed variance power. N , N..zero , percent.zero : Aligned sample count, number positive measurements, rounded percentage observed measurements equal zero. Missing model covariates can reduce particular fit’s effective sample count. return_all = TRUE keeps full result table memory. default returns rows qval <= max_significance (default 0.05). empty default table means returned associations meet cutoff, rather models attempted. Failed fits produce feature-named warnings absent result table; inspect warnings interpreting results. number hypotheses covers selected features; q-values results testing entire source dataset. first displayed diagnosis association Clostridium bolteae CD relative nonIBD: coefficient 3.13 adjusted p-value 0.0351. second Bacteroides massiliensis, coefficient -3.85 adjusted p-value 0.0494. positive coefficient indicates higher fitted relative abundance negative coefficient lower fitted relative abundance, adjusting age antibiotic use. conditional associations subset, evidence causality.

text: Adjust Tweedieverse(differential analysis methods) coefficient estimates p-values testing taxon *median* effect metadata variable - simple post-hoc strategy curb false discoveries driven compositional nature microbiome count data (approach adopted **MaAsLin 3**).

title: Median Comparison for Compositionality Adjustment — median_comparison_tweedie
code: median_comparison_tweedie(     df,     p_cutoff = 0.95,     subtract_median = FALSE,     n_sims = 10000,     median_threshold = 0,     seed = NULL )

title: Median Comparison for Compositionality Adjustment — median_comparison_tweedie
text: df `data.frame` returned **Tweedieverse** differential analysis methods containing (    minimum) columns     `taxon`, `metadata`, `effect_size`, `pval`, `stderr`, `qval`. p_cutoff Numeric.  Upper bound original p-value include effect median calculation (default `0.95` = non-missing). subtract_median Logical.  `TRUE`, subtracts group median every coefficient returning `coef_median`; otherwise original `effect_size` copied unchanged (default `FALSE`). n_sims Integer.  Number Monte-Carlo simulations used estimate covariance coefficient group median (default `10 000`). median_threshold Numeric.  Absolute difference coefficient considered effectively equal median assigned `pval_median = 1` (default `0`). seed Optional non-negative integer seed simulations. Default NULL, uses current random-number stream. supplied seed scoped withr restores preceding random-number state function exits.

title: Median Comparison for Compositionality Adjustment — median_comparison_tweedie
text: input `df` two new columns: `coef_median` Median-centred coefficient (original     `effect_size` `subtract_median = FALSE`). `pval_median` Two-sided p-value median-comparison test.

title: Median Comparison for Compositionality Adjustment — median_comparison_tweedie
text: every distinct value `metadata` algorithm keeps coefficients `pval < p_cutoff` computes median; simulates `n_sims` draws coefficients using normal         approximation (`N(effect_size, stderr^2)`) records empirical         distribution simulated medians; derives variance-inflated *offset* accounts         covariance coefficient group median; performs two-sided Z-test `H0 : beta_i = offset_i`, returning         resulting p-value `pval_median`.

title: Median Comparison for Compositionality Adjustment — median_comparison_tweedie
text: procedure heuristic relies normal approximations.  Results may unstable small sample sizes `stderr` values zero missing.
